name: Dipula Properties Limited
source: Audited condensed consolidated financial results for the year ended 31 August 2026 (Forvis Mazars unmodified opinion), statement of comprehensive income, R000. Revenue 1,671,382 is contractual rental income 1,244,105 plus municipal and property recoveries 436,197 less the straight-line rental adjustment 8,920. Cost of Sales 645,543 is the printed property-related expenses. Gross Profit is Revenue less Cost of Sales. Operating Expenses 69,817 is administration and corporate costs 55,034 plus expected credit losses 14,783. EBIT 956,022 is the printed net property income 1,011,056 less administration and corporate costs 55,034. The statement's fair value adjustments of 617,189 (investment property 581,800, straight-line adjustment 8,920, interest rate swaps 26,469) sit outside the panel's rows and reconcile EBIT to the printed profit before taxation 1,264,805: 956,022 + 617,189 - net finance cost 308,406 = 1,264,805. Net finance cost is finance cost 342,243 less finance income 33,837. No taxation was charged. Profit for the year 1,264,805 includes 25,813 attributable to non-controlling interests, leaving 1,238,992 for equity holders. Basic earnings per share 122.05 cents (diluted 120.15 cents).
